name: SurveyMonkey
oneLiner: General-purpose online survey platform with AI survey building and analysis, templates (including restaurant feedback), multichannel distribution and a paid respondent panel.
bestFor: Independent restaurants and small groups that want a familiar, low-cost way to run guest satisfaction, NPS, menu or staff surveys without a restaurant-specific platform (no POS integration or location benchmarking out of the box).

updates.text: Relaunched as 'Today's SurveyMonkey', with a conversational AI survey builder that drafts and refines surveys from plain-language requests, automated analysis, and HRIS integrations with Workday and BambooHR.
Launched a SurveyMonkey plugin in ChatGPT for creating surveys and analyzing responses inside AI workflows, following a Claude connector.
Opened a free tools hub where anyone can generate an AI-built survey and use research and analysis tools without signing up.

features: SurveyMonkey AI: build a survey from a plain-language prompt and refine it conversationally
Large template library, including restaurant feedback, NPS and CSAT surveys
Skip logic, branching, piping and A/B testing on paid plans
Distribution by web link, email, QR code, website embed, SMS and social
Real-time dashboards, filters, cross-tabs and AI-assisted analysis of open-ended answers
Integrations such as Salesforce, Microsoft Power BI and Slack for alerts and reporting
SurveyMonkey Audience paid panel for market research with targeted respondents

pricing.text: Published plans: a free Basic plan (limited responses), individual paid plans (monthly or annual) and Team plans billed per user annually with a minimum of 3 seats; Enterprise is custom-quoted. Prices vary by region and billing, so check the pricing page.

notes: COMPANY NAME: the 'Momentive' parent name was dropped. Momentive was taken private by a Symphony Technology Group-led consortium for about $1.5B (closed May 31, 2023: https://www.surveymonkey.com/newsroom/stg-completes-acquisition-of-momentive-global/) and in June 2023 the company returned to the SurveyMonkey name under CEO Eric Johnson (https://www.surveymonkey.com/newsroom/momentive-eric-johnson-ceo-return-to-surveymonkey/). Fix the current review's 'now operating under the parent brand Momentive'. Founded 1999 and headquartered in San Mateo per the current review; not re-verified. Dropped/not re-verified: '25+ question types', '400+ templates', 'Audience panel of 335 million+ respondents across 130+ countries'. SurveyMonkey AI is limited to US data center accounts in English per SurveyMonkey help (July 2026). Exact US prices differ across third-party trackers (e.g. Team Advantage ~$30/user/month, Team Premier $75-92/user/month), so none are quoted. No restaurant-specific customer story found.
